svg.aria-label: A staircase of three steps. On the first, a person does the task by hand and learns the shape of the problem. On the second, they write it down as a script. On the third, the script runs on its own, triggered by a hook or a schedule, while the person has walked off to the next problem.
svg.text: THE THIRD TIME, IT RUNS ITSELF
learn the shape of the problem
feel the itch, write a script
skipping a step is a mistake: you can't automate a shape you haven't seen
